title: Transfer: Harden CSV Metrics Validation Tests
goal: Fix a CSV metrics importer that silently mishandles malformed numeric fields and duplicate headers; build parameterized pytest coverage for valid and invalid rows, then correct the importer so the expected records and errors are produced.
skillBenefitRationale: Success centers on expressing input variations as clean pytest cases, validating parser outcomes, and using those tests to drive the implementation fix, so testing-python is the unique key shipped skill.
